author: PotatoStealer_
body:
As you can see from the title, this suggestion is regarding the tablists and the global chat option.

The tablists is quite a mess right now and needs more organization.


  1. Team color organization - Organize teams by their colors
      2.Show player's name in italics or bold

Chat options as well.
  1. Allow players to do /t <message> instead of /t, then typing the message.
  2. Same goes for /g. /g Allows players to toggle from global to team instead of typing /t to disable, then typing the message.
